'''Warrior-seer''' was the title conferred upon a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] who performed the dual tasks of [[Warrior caste|warrior]] and [[Seer (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|seer]]. The bridging of the two castes&mdash;that of warrior and [[Priest caste|priest]]&mdash;was intended to allow for the will of the [[Yun'o|Yuuzhan Vong gods]] to be studied and supplicated during the prosecution of warfare. Warrior-seers provided both religious and tactical advice to senior [[Commander/Legends|commanders]]. During the [[29 ABY/Legends|last year]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Warmaster]] [[Nas Choka]] was counseled by his [[Nas Choka's seer|personal warrior-seer]].
